root_cause_label: Agent exhausts step budget on redundant verification without ever calling the submission tool
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly implemented and verified the full audio pipeline by step 21 but then spent steps 22-34 performing redundant manual checks of STFT bin values, exhausting the step budget without ever signaling task completion.
t_err_evidence: Step 22 begins redundant structural verification (`ls -la /app/` and `ls -la /app/data/`) despite the pipeline already being confirmed correct in step 21; the agent enters an unneeded verification loop instead of submitting.
t_commit_evidence: Step 34 is the final step of the trajectory; the agent verifies peaks.csv for frame 1 and the trajectory ends with no submission call, confirming the step budget was exhausted.
trigger_explanation: The agent never acknowledged the requirement to call a completion or submission tool to signal task completion. After achieving a correct environment state (step 21), it defaulted to continued verification rather than submitting, implicitly dropping the completion protocol requirement.
